The claims concern AAPL, which is in the book, and `alter_existing_thesis` has already returned two suggestions (AAPL.p1 and AAPL.p2). `spawn_new_thesis` is not needed because the alter call did return changes for AAPL. Two claims state forward figures with a metric, period, value and unit: Services growth of 12% for FY2026 (c6) and EPS of $8.10 for FY2026 (c7). The consensus EPS (c8) is a consensus figure, not the email's own projection, and the P/E multiple (c9) is not one of the listed metrics, so I leave both out. The target price (c2) has no period, so it does not qualify. I will call `revise_projections` for AAPL with c6 and c7.
